annotations.annotation_text: Anna Livia Plurabelle (ALP), the archetypal feminine principle, mother, and personification of the River Liffey flowing through Dublin to the sea, manifested as "Liffey".

annotations.annotation_text: The nocturnal oneiric dimension (sleep): Joyce's exploration of the sleeping body, sensory deprivation, auditory distortions, and the somatic language of the collective unconscious.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish

annotations.annotation_text: Universal archetype of the father and everyman protagonist Humphrey Chimpden Earwicker (HCE), manifested here as "builder". Represents the recumbent Dublin landscape with head at Howth and body stretching west to Phoenix Park.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
